requirements.evidence: All contract pieces are present: CreateQueue trims/derives the slug, validates 1-255 and creates active queues (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:21-40); UpdateQueue supports nullable name/slug/isActive and keeps the queue's own slug (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:22-72); SetQueueAccess enforces manager authorization, entity matching, the permission whitelist and grant/revoke audit events (app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:27-72); QueuePolicy implements create/update/manageAccess/call (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:14-59); both call paths authorize (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32, app/Models/Ticket.php:100-115). The remaining gap is the DB-specific unique-violation detection (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:61-76, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:82-97), which misses PostgreSQL's 23505/lowercase message.

conventions.evidence: One action per use case (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php, UpdateQueue.php, SetQueueAccess.php), authorization through a policy (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php), a generated-style reversible migration (database/migrations/2026_10_29_045945_create_queue_access_table.php:14-21), deliberate fillable attributes (app/Models/QueueAccess.php:11), and the three requested docs updates (CHANGELOG.md:21-23, docs/business-rules.md:104-111, docs/database-schema.md:142,156-157).

security.evidence: Every write authorizes before touching data: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:18, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:22, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:27, app/Models/Ticket.php:104, app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:32. Permissions are restricted to QueuePermission::values() (app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:37-43), name/slug input is validated (app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:23-30), QueueAccess mass assignment is limited to its three columns (app/Models/QueueAccess.php:11), and QueuePolicy is deny-by-default for non-members and non-managers (app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:34-58).

tests.evidence: Broad new Pest suites cover create/update/access/policy/call paths, including unauthorized actors, every call mode, inactive-before-authorization, corrupted grants and self-grant denial (tests/Feature/Queue/CreateQueueTest.php, UpdateQueueTest.php, SetQueueAccessTest.php, QueuePolicyTest.php, QueueCallAuthorizationTest.php). The update race test is ineffective (tests/Feature/Queue/UpdateQueueTest.php:83-105) and the schema test only checks column presence (tests/Feature/Queue/QueueAccessTest.php:11-52).

simplicity.evidence: The actions are small and direct and reuse the existing Queue, Ticket and EntityMembership models plus Gate. The main duplication is ensureSlugIsAvailable() and rethrowUniqueViolation(), copied almost verbatim between app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:47-76 and app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:67-97.

readability.evidence: Clear names and focused methods; the lock order and why queue_id is re-read are explained at app/Models/Ticket.php:87-98; the code matches the sibling action/model style and contains no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: The diff is limited to the queue lifecycle/access domain, the queue_access migration/model/factory/enum, authorization on both call paths, their tests, and the three requested docs. The CallNextTicketTest edits only supply the authorized callers the new policy now requires (tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php:18-29).

issues.explanation: The database-race case pre-creates a queue with slug 'corrida' (line 87), so UpdateQueue throws in ensureSlugIsAvailable before saving and the QueryException branch at app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:58-63 is never exercised.
ensureSlugIsAvailable() and rethrowUniqueViolation() are duplicated almost verbatim in both actions, so a future change to the slug rules must be made twice.

The unique-violation check treats every SQLSTATE 23000 as a slug duplicate and matches UNIQUE/Duplicate case-sensitively, so it can mislabel other integrity errors and misses PostgreSQL's 23505/lowercase message, letting a race surface as a raw QueryException.
The schema test only verifies that the columns exist; it does not check that the (entity_membership_id, queue_id) unique key is enforced or that deleting a membership/queue cascades to queue_access.

QueuePolicy depends on User::membershipFor() and App\Models\UserRole, neither of which is introduced by this diff; their existence and semantics are not verifiable from the provided files, and if absent every ability fails at runtime.

review.summary: The change implements the queue lifecycle actions, queue_access persistence, the SetQueueAccess audit trail, and QueuePolicy enforcement on both call paths, with the requested docs and broad Pest coverage. The contract is essentially met, but the unique-violation handling is DB-specific, the new update race test never reaches the catch branch, and the shared slug logic is duplicated, so it is an approve-with-minor-changes review.
